parameters.name: AcrRegistryInfo
parameters.description: Information about the ACR Enterprise instance.

sub_parameters.name: Domain
sub_parameters.description: The domain names of the ACR Enterprise instance. By default, this includes all domain names for the instance. You can specify one or more domain names, separated by commas.

sub_parameters.name: InstanceId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the ACR Enterprise instance.

sub_parameters.name: InstanceName
sub_parameters.description: The name of the ACR Enterprise instance.

sub_parameters.name: RegionId
sub_parameters.description: The region of the ACR Enterprise instance.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique parameter value from your client. The value can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence]().

parameters.name: Container
parameters.description: Specifies the new container group configuration.

sub_parameters.name: Arg
sub_parameters.description: The startup arguments for the container. You can specify up to 10 arguments.

sub_parameters.name: Command
sub_parameters.description: The startup command for the container. You can specify up to 20 commands. Each command can be up to 256 characters in length.

sub_parameters.name: Cpu
sub_parameters.description: The vCPU size of the container.

sub_parameters.name: EnvironmentVar
sub_parameters.description: The list of environment variables for the container.

sub_parameters.name: Gpu
sub_parameters.description: The number of GPUs for the container.

sub_parameters.name: Image
sub_parameters.description: The container image.

sub_parameters.name: ImagePullPolicy
sub_parameters.description:
The image pull policy. Valid values:

- Always: Always pulls the image.

- IfNotPresent: Pulls the image only if it is not present locally.

- Never: Never pulls the image. Uses the local image.

sub_parameters.name: LifecyclePostStartHandlerExec
sub_parameters.description: The command to run in the container when you use the command line to set the postStart callback function.

sub_parameters.name: LifecyclePostStartHandlerHttpGetHost
sub_parameters.description: The host address that receives the HTTP GET request when you use an HTTP request to set the postStart callback function.

sub_parameters.name: LifecyclePostStartHandlerHttpGetHttpHeaders
sub_parameters.description: The collection of valid HTTP request headers in the generated HTTP request.

sub_parameters.name: LifecyclePostStartHandlerHttpGetPath
sub_parameters.description: The path for the HTTP GET request check when you use an HTTP request to set the postStart callback function.

sub_parameters.name: LifecyclePostStartHandlerHttpGetPort
sub_parameters.description: The port for the HTTP GET request check when you use an HTTP request to set the postStart callback function.

sub_parameters.name: LifecyclePostStartHandlerHttpGetScheme
sub_parameters.description: The path for the HTTP GET request check when you use an HTTP request to set the postStart callback function.

sub_parameters.name: LifecyclePostStartHandlerTcpSocketHost
sub_parameters.description: The host address for the TCP socket check when you use a TCP Socket to set the postStart callback function.

sub_parameters.name: LifecyclePostStartHandlerTcpSocketPort
sub_parameters.description: The port for the TCP socket check when you use a TCPSocket to set the postStart callback function.

sub_parameters.name: LifecyclePreStopHandlerExec
sub_parameters.description: The command to run in the container when you use the command line to set the preStop callback function.

sub_parameters.name: LifecyclePreStopHandlerHttpGetHost
sub_parameters.description: The host address that receives the HTTP GET request when you use an HTTP request to set the preStop callback function.

sub_parameters.name: LifecyclePreStopHandlerHttpGetHttpHeader
sub_parameters.description: The generated HTTP request header information.

sub_parameters.name: LifecyclePreStopHandlerHttpGetPath
sub_parameters.description: The path for the HTTP GET request check when you use an HTTP request to set the preStop callback function.

sub_parameters.name: LifecyclePreStopHandlerHttpGetPort
sub_parameters.description: The port for the HTTP GET request check when you use an HTTP request to set the preStop callback function.

sub_parameters.name: LifecyclePreStopHandlerHttpGetScheme
sub_parameters.description:
The protocol type for the HTTP GET request when you use an HTTP request to set the preStop callback function. Valid values:

- HTTP

- HTTPS

sub_parameters.name: LifecyclePreStopHandlerTcpSocketHost
sub_parameters.description: The host address for the TCP socket check when you use a TCP Socket to set the preStop callback function.

sub_parameters.name: LifecyclePreStopHandlerTcpSocketPort
sub_parameters.description: The port for the TCP socket check when you use a TCPSocket to set the preStop callback function.

sub_parameters.name: LivenessProbe.Exec.Command
sub_parameters.description: The command to run for the check in the container.

sub_parameters.name: LivenessProbe.FailureThreshold
sub_parameters.description: The number of consecutive failed checks required to determine that the check has failed after a success. The default is 3.

sub_parameters.name: LivenessProbe.HttpGet.Path
sub_parameters.description: The path for the HttpGet check.

sub_parameters.name: LivenessProbe.HttpGet.Port
sub_parameters.description: The port for the HttpGet check.

sub_parameters.name: LivenessProbe.HttpGet.Scheme
sub_parameters.description:
The protocol type for the HTTP GET request when you use an HTTP request for a health check. Valid values:

- HTTP

- HTTPS

sub_parameters.name: LivenessProbe.InitialDelaySeconds
sub_parameters.description: The time when the check starts. The time is calculated from when the container starts.

sub_parameters.name: LivenessProbe.PeriodSeconds
sub_parameters.description: The interval at which the check is performed. The default is 10 seconds. The minimum is 1 second.

sub_parameters.name: LivenessProbe.SuccessThreshold
sub_parameters.description: The number of consecutive successful checks required to determine that the check is successful after a failure. The default is 1. The value must be 1.

sub_parameters.name: LivenessProbe.TcpSocket.Port
sub_parameters.description: The port for the TcpSocket check.

sub_parameters.name: LivenessProbe.TimeoutSeconds
sub_parameters.description: The timeout period for the check. The default is 1 second. The minimum is 1 second.

sub_parameters.name: Memory
sub_parameters.description: The memory size of the container.

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description: The name of the container.

sub_parameters.name: Port
sub_parameters.description: The container port. Valid values: 1 to 65535.

sub_parameters.name: ReadinessProbe.Exec.Command
sub_parameters.description: The command to run for the check in the container.

sub_parameters.name: ReadinessProbe.FailureThreshold
sub_parameters.description: The number of consecutive failed checks required to determine that the check has failed after a success. The default is 3.

sub_parameters.name: ReadinessProbe.HttpGet.Path
sub_parameters.description: The path for the HttpGet check.

sub_parameters.name: ReadinessProbe.HttpGet.Port
sub_parameters.description: The port for the HttpGet check.

sub_parameters.name: ReadinessProbe.HttpGet.Scheme
sub_parameters.description:
The protocol type for the HTTP GET request when you use an HTTP request for a health check. Valid values:

- HTTP

- HTTPS

sub_parameters.name: ReadinessProbe.InitialDelaySeconds
sub_parameters.description: The time when the check starts. The time is calculated from when the container starts.

sub_parameters.name: ReadinessProbe.PeriodSeconds
sub_parameters.description: The interval at which the check is performed. The default is 10 seconds. The minimum is 1 second.

sub_parameters.name: ReadinessProbe.SuccessThreshold
sub_parameters.description: The number of consecutive successful checks required to determine that the check is successful after a failure. The default is 1.

sub_parameters.name: ReadinessProbe.TcpSocket.Port
sub_parameters.description: The port for the TcpSocket check.

sub_parameters.name: ReadinessProbe.TimeoutSeconds
sub_parameters.description: The timeout period for the check. The default is 1 second. The minimum is 1 second.

sub_parameters.name: SecurityContext.Capability.Add
sub_parameters.description:
Grants specific permissions to processes in the container. Currently, only NET\_ADMIN and NET\_RAW are supported.

> NET\_RAW is not supported by default. To use it, submit a ticket.

sub_parameters.name: SecurityContext.ReadOnlyRootFilesystem
sub_parameters.description: Indicates whether the root file system is read-only. Currently, only \`true\` is supported.

sub_parameters.name: SecurityContext.RunAsUser
sub_parameters.description: The UID used to run the entry point of the container process.

sub_parameters.name: Stdin
sub_parameters.description: Indicates whether to allocate a buffer for standard input in the container runtime. If not set, reading from standard input in the container results in an End-Of-File (EOF). The default is false.

sub_parameters.name: StdinOnce
sub_parameters.description: When standard input is true, the standard input stream remains open across multiple attach sessions. If StdinOnce is set to true, standard input is opened when the container starts and is empty until the first client attaches to standard input. It then remains open to receive data until the client disconnects. At that point, standard input is closed and remains closed until the container restarts.

sub_parameters.name: Tty
sub_parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable interaction. The default is false. If the Command is of the /bin/bash type, set this to true.

sub_parameters.name: VolumeMount
sub_parameters.description: The list of volumes to mount to the container.

sub_parameters.name: WorkingDir
sub_parameters.description: The working directory of the container.

parameters.name: ContainerGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the ECI instance that you want to update. This is the container group ID.

parameters.name: Cpu
parameters.description: The number of vCPUs for the instance (container group).

parameters.name: DnsConfig.NameServer
parameters.description: The list of IP addresses of DNS servers.

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description: The name of the option variable for the DNS configuration.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the option variable for the DNS configuration.

parameters.name: DnsConfig.Search
parameters.description: The list of DNS search domains.

parameters.name: ImageRegistryCredential
parameters.description: A list of image repository credentials.

sub_parameters.name: Password
sub_parameters.description: The password for the image repository.

sub_parameters.name: Server
sub_parameters.description: The address of the image repository without the `http://` or `https://` prefix.

sub_parameters.name: UserName
sub_parameters.description: The username for the image repository.

parameters.name: InitContainer
parameters.description: Specifies the new Init container information.

sub_parameters.name: Arg
sub_parameters.description: The startup arguments for the init container.

sub_parameters.name: Command
sub_parameters.description: The command for the init container.

sub_parameters.name: Cpu
sub_parameters.description: The number of vCPUs for the init container.

sub_parameters.name: EnvironmentVar
sub_parameters.description: The environment variables of the container.

sub_parameters.name: Gpu
sub_parameters.description: The number of GPUs for the init container.

sub_parameters.name: Image
sub_parameters.description: The container image for the init container.

sub_parameters.name: ImagePullPolicy
sub_parameters.description:
The image pull policy. Valid values:

- Always: The image is always pulled.

- IfNotPresent: The local image is used first. If the image is not available locally, it is pulled.

- Never: The image is never pulled. Only the local image is used.

sub_parameters.name: Memory
sub_parameters.description: The memory size of the init container.

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description: The name of the init container.

sub_parameters.name: Port
sub_parameters.description: The port number. The valid range is 1 to 65535.

sub_parameters.name: SecurityContext.Capability.Add
sub_parameters.description:
Grants specific permissions to processes in the container. Only NET\_ADMIN and NET\_RAW are supported.

> NET\_RAW is not supported by default. Submit a ticket to request this permission.

sub_parameters.name: SecurityContext.ReadOnlyRootFilesystem
sub_parameters.description: Specifies whether the root file system of the container is read-only. The only valid value is \`true\`.

sub_parameters.name: SecurityContext.RunAsUser
sub_parameters.description: The user ID to run the container.

sub_parameters.name: Stdin
sub_parameters.description: Specifies whether to allocate a buffer for the container's standard input. If not set, reading from standard input returns an End-of-File (EOF). The default is false.

sub_parameters.name: StdinOnce
sub_parameters.description: When standard input is enabled, the standard input stream remains open across multiple attach sessions. If you set StdinOnce to true, the standard input is opened when the container starts. The stream is empty until the first client attaches. It then accepts data until the client disconnects. After the client disconnects, the stream is closed and remains closed until the container is restarted.

sub_parameters.name: Tty
sub_parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable interaction. The default value is false. If Command is set to /bin/bash, set this parameter to true.

sub_parameters.name: VolumeMount
sub_parameters.description: The list of volume mounts.

sub_parameters.name: WorkingDir
sub_parameters.description: The working directory of the init container.

parameters.name: Memory
parameters.description: The memory size for the instance (container group). Unit: GiB.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: RestartPolicy
parameters.description:
The restart policy of the instance. Valid values:

- Always: Always restarts the instance.

- Never: Never restarts the instance.

- OnFailure: Restarts the instance upon failure.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The list of tags to attach to the instance.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value.

parameters.name: UpdateType
parameters.description:
The update type. Valid values:

- RenewUpdate: A full update. You must specify all related parameters. You cannot update individual items in a list or individual members in a struct.

- IncrementalUpdate: An incremental update. You can specify only the parameters that you want to update. Unspecified parameters remain unchanged.

The default is RenewUpdate.

sub_parameters.name: ConfigFileVolume.ConfigFileToPath
sub_parameters.description: The configuration file information for the ConfigFile volume.

sub_parameters.name: EmptyDirVolume.Medium
sub_parameters.description: The storage medium of the EmptyDir volume. The default is an empty string, which means that the node's file system is used. You can set this to Memory to use memory.

sub_parameters.name: EmptyDirVolume.SizeLimit
sub_parameters.description: The size of the EmptyDir volume. Specify the unit for the value, such as Gi or Mi.

sub_parameters.name: FlexVolume.Driver
sub_parameters.description:
The driver type when you use a FlexVolume plug-in to mount a volume. Valid values:

- alicloud/disk: Mounts a disk.

- alicloud/nas: Mounts a NAS file system.

- alicloud/oss: Mounts an OSS bucket.

sub_parameters.name: FlexVolume.FsType
sub_parameters.description: The file system type of the disk when you use a FlexVolume plug-in to mount the disk. Valid values include ext4, ext3, xfs, and vfat. The default value is ext4.

sub_parameters.name: FlexVolume.Options
sub_parameters.description: The list of FlexVolume options. The options are key-value pairs in JSON format. For example, when you mount a disk using FlexVolume, Options specifies the configuration parameters of the disk. For more information, see [Volume overview]().

sub_parameters.name: HostPathVolume.Path
sub_parameters.description:
The path of the HostPath volume on the host.

> This parameter is not yet available.

sub_parameters.name: HostPathVolume.Type
sub_parameters.description:
The type of the HostPath volume. Valid values:

- Directory: a directory.

- File: a file.

> This parameter is not yet available.

sub_parameters.name: NFSVolume.Path
sub_parameters.description: The path to mount on the NFS volume.

sub_parameters.name: NFSVolume.ReadOnly
sub_parameters.description:
The read-only permission for the NFS volume. Valid values:

- true: The NFS volume is read-only.

- false: The NFS volume is read-write.

sub_parameters.name: NFSVolume.Server
sub_parameters.description: The address of the NFS mount target.

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description: The name of the volume.

sub_parameters.name: Type
sub_parameters.description:
The type of the volume. Valid values:

- EmptyDirVolume: An EmptyDir volume. This is a temporary directory.

- ConfigFileVolume: A ConfigFile volume. This is a configuration file.

- NFSVolume: An NFS volume. This is a network file system, such as a Network Attached Storage (NAS) system.

- FlexVolume: A FlexVolume plug-in to extend the storage type. You can use it to mount disks, NAS, and Object Storage Service (OSS).

- HostPathVolume: A HostPath volume. This is a file or directory on the host. This value is not yet available.
